title: Simple Past
subtitle: Afirmações, negativas e perguntas
lesson: Afirmativa: verbo no passado. Negativa: didn’t + forma básica. Pergunta: Did + sujeito + forma básica? Marcadores: yesterday, last night, last year.

questions.prompt: Passe para a negativa: Lucas went to the park.
answers: Lucas didn't go to the park.
Lucas did not go to the park.
questions.explanation: Depois de didn’t, go volta à forma básica.

questions.prompt: Passe para a negativa: They had lunch at school.
answers: They didn't have lunch at school.
They did not have lunch at school.
questions.explanation: Had volta a have depois de didn’t.

questions.prompt: Transforme em pergunta: You went to the beach yesterday.
answers: Did you go to the beach yesterday?
questions.explanation: Did + sujeito + verbo na forma básica.

questions.prompt: Transforme em pergunta: She gave you a pencil.
answers: Did she give you a pencil?
questions.explanation: Gave volta a give depois de did.

questions.prompt: I have breakfast at seven every day. → Use yesterday.
answers: I had breakfast at seven yesterday.
questions.explanation: Use a forma do passado na afirmativa e o marcador de tempo solicitado.

questions.prompt: She wears a blue dress every Sunday. → Use last Sunday.
answers: She wore a blue dress last Sunday.
questions.explanation: Use a forma do passado na afirmativa e o marcador de tempo solicitado.

questions.prompt: The lesson begins at eight every morning. → Use yesterday morning.
answers: The lesson began at eight yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: Use a forma do passado na afirmativa e o marcador de tempo solicitado.
Esta é a forma irregular do verbo no simple past.

questions.prompt: She ___ a blue dress last Sunday.
questions.explanation: Esta é a forma irregular do verbo no simple past.

questions.prompt: The lesson ___ at eight yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: Esta é a forma irregular do verbo no simple past.

questions.prompt: We ___ about the answer last night.
questions.explanation: Esta é a forma irregular do verbo no simple past.

questions.prompt: They ___ to the park last Saturday.
questions.explanation: Esta é a forma irregular do verbo no simple past.
Depois de did, use a forma básica.
Depois de didn’t, use wear, não wore.

questions.prompt: Passe para o passado: We play football. (yesterday)
Resposta curta negativa: Did you go to school?
